text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): after two PlanReview attempts failed with the same fingerprint (maxSameFailureFingerprint 2), execution-core returned retryMode strategy-change (REPEATED_FAILURE_STRATEGY_CHANGE). Every surface then refuses: propose --resume with plan-review-retry throws PLAN_REVIEW_RETRY_STRATEGY_CHANGE_REQUIRED before policyChanged is even computed (propose-orchestrator.ts near the executionGrantAuthorization check); `job retry-request --timeout <different>` throws RETRY_MODE_MISMATCH because the job surface derives execution-policy-change from the policy diff; `job retry-request` with the same timeout throws EXECUTION_RUNTIME_POLICY_CHANGE_INVALID; and no bounded replacement grant request exists because the strategy-change decision carries no requiredGrant, so `grant approve` has nothing to sign. The survey path (investigation-session.ts) already accepts strategy-change when the provider execution policy changed and records strategyChanges ["provider-execution-policy-changed"]; the plan-review path should mirror it, or the decision should offer a grant exit.
